segments.he: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר דַּיָּהּ וְכוּ׳. תַּנְיָא: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר מִשּׁוּם רַבִּי טַרְפוֹן: דַּיָּהּ חׇדְשָׁהּ, וְיֵשׁ בַּדָּבָר לְהָקֵל וּלְהַחֲמִיר.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that «Rabbi Yehuda says:» It is «sufficient» that a woman is not rendered a zava on account of blood that is emitted due to labor pains only from within one month of her due date. In this regard, it «is taught» in a baraita that «Rabbi Yehuda says in the name of Rabbi Tarfon:» It is «sufficient for her» not to be rendered a zava from within one «month» of «her» due date. «And there is» an aspect of «leniency and» an aspect of «stringency in the matter.»
